messages.author: 996d29a26590fed6
messages.subject: ggplot2 graphical interface
parts:
Hi Hadley and others

I find this package very nice, and as part of another project have
tried to produce a graphical interface to help beginners to learn the
syntax is, and explore the layers that are available. The idea is the
following : to use the object structure of the project to display the
default aes and parameters in a graphical interface. When the
aesthetics and parameters and layering have been chosen, then the
graph is displayed along with the formula for that graph. I'm not an
expert programmer but I've tried to produce "a draft" of a package
along that line of thought. It is not finished, and sometimes
especially if you try to build up the layers, the results are weird,
but it should work fine for simple layers.
Before continuing with this program, I would like your opinion.
I've downloaded the package both in zip format and as a tarball in the
documents of this group. It's called ggplot2usr for ggplot2 user
graphical interface. Just install it (it is built for R 2.10), and
then run
library(ggplot2usr)
example(ggplot2usr)
I expect that gtk+ will install when loading gWidgetsRGtk2

Cedric
